headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.interior_cap
headlines.statement:
∀ (a b S c K : ℝ),
  0 < a → 0 < b → a ≤ S → 0 ≤ c → c ≤ K * max a b → c * Math115.RetainedRoot.interiorCoefficient a b S ≤ K

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.endpoint_cap
headlines.statement:
∀ (a b S c K M : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < b →
      a ≤ b → a ≤ S → S ≤ M * a → 0 ≤ c → c ≤ K * b → c * Math115.RetainedRoot.endpointCoefficient a b S ≤ K * (M + 1)

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.fullCoefficient_bound
headlines.statement: ∀ (p V : ℕ), 2 ≤ p → 2 ≤ V → Math115.RetainedRoot.fullCoefficient p V ≤ 2 * ↑p ^ 3 * ↑V ^ 3

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.rational_uniform_d13
headlines.statement:
∀ (p V Q d : ℕ),
  2 ≤ p →
    2 ≤ V → Q ≤ 4 * p - 3 → p ≤ d → V ≤ 5 * d ^ 3 → 4 * ↑Q * Math115.RetainedRoot.fullCoefficient p V ≤ 4000 * ↑d ^ 13

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.dyadic_uniform_d13
headlines.statement:
∀ (p V Q d : ℕ),
  2 ≤ p →
    2 ≤ V →
      1 ≤ Q →
        Q ≤ 4 * p - 3 →
          p ≤ d →
            V ≤ 5 * d ^ 3 →
              2 * ↑(Math115.RetainedRoot.dyadicDenominator Q) * Math115.RetainedRoot.fullCoefficient p V ≤
                8000 * ↑d ^ 13

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.rational_uniform_d10
headlines.statement:
∀ (p V Q d : ℕ),
  2 ≤ p →
    2 ≤ V → Q ≤ 4 * p - 3 → p ≤ d → V ≤ 11 * d ^ 2 → 4 * ↑Q * Math115.RetainedRoot.fullCoefficient p V ≤ 42592 * ↑d ^ 10

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRoot.dyadic_uniform_d10
headlines.statement:
∀ (p V Q d : ℕ),
  2 ≤ p →
    2 ≤ V →
      1 ≤ Q →
        Q ≤ 4 * p - 3 →
          p ≤ d →
            V ≤ 11 * d ^ 2 →
              2 * ↑(Math115.RetainedRoot.dyadicDenominator Q) * Math115.RetainedRoot.fullCoefficient p V ≤
                85184 * ↑d ^ 10

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRootPhysical.adjacent_physical_leaf_transport_retained
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J]
  (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (s : I × J) (hs : small s.1 s.2 = true)
  (σ : I × J → ℕ) (U l : ℕ),
  2 ≤ U →
    1 ≤ l →
      l ≤ U →
        (∀ (i : I) (j : J), small i j = false → 2 ≤ B i j) →
          (∀ (a : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Earlier small s), σ ↑↑a ≤ U) →
            ∀ {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Later small s)
              (H : OAI.ContingencyTables.PhysicalCompletionFibres.SmallProfile small → ℝ),
              0 <
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U))
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1)) →
                0 <
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U)
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U))
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l) →
                  let Ms := OAI.ContingencyTables.LargePairEnumeration.widths fun x => U;
                  have f :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperContextTransport.contextHard small B r c L Ms
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U);
                  have a :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1));
                  have b :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l);
                  have A :=
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.FactorialSignatures.integerRemovalMatrix
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.correctionKernel Ms f)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.rootDisplay U l);
                  have h := fun p => H (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.assemble small s hs σ U e p);
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms (fun p => f p * h p)
                            (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U (l - 1)) /
                          a -
                        OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms (fun p => f p * h p)
                            (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.childProfile U l) /
                          b) ^
                      2 ≤
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient A a b *
                      Math115.PhysicalLeafEnergy.physicalLeafEnergy small s hs σ U l e
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstPaperPhysicalMarginal.hardMarginal small B r c L) H

                  have f :=

                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.contextEquiv small s hs e U)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextEnumeration.prefixRaw small s σ U);
                  have a :=

headlines.name: Math115.RetainedRootPhysical.retainedRootCoefficient_shift
headlines.statement:
∀ (F : (Bool → ℕ) → ℝ) (U l : ℕ) (s t : ℝ),
  1 ≤ l →
    l ≤ U →
      OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FactorialSignatures.integerRemovalMatrix F
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.rootDisplay U l))
          s t =
        1 / s + 1 / t -
              (if 2 ≤ l then F (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U (l - 1)) else 0) / s ^ 2 +
            2 * F (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U l) / (s * t) -
          (if l < U then F (OAI.ContingencyTables.ExcessContextProfiles.auxRoot U (l + 1)) else 0) / t ^ 2

headlines.name: OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient_nonnegative_limit
headlines.statement:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {l : Filter K} [l.NeBot] (Ms : List ℕ)
  (F : K → (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ) → ℝ)
  (f : (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ) → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t => F t x) l (nhds (f x))) →
    ∀ (m z : Bool → ℕ) (R : ℕ),
      (∀ U ∈ Ms, 2 ≤ U) →
        (∀ᶠ (t : K) in l,
            (∀ (x : OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.Coordinates Bool Ms → ℕ), 0 ≤ F t x) ∧
              OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedBox.PositiveSlice (F t) (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds m Ms)
                  (R + Ms.sum) ∧
                OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedBox.RemovalSlice (F t) (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.bounds m Ms)
                  (R + Ms.sum)) →
          OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedBox.InBox m z →
            ∑ i, z i = R + 1 →
              0 <
                  OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z false →
                0 <
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z true →
                  0 ≤
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.retainedRootCoefficient
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FactorialSignatures.integerRemovalMatrix
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.correctionKernel Ms f) z)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z false)
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.IntegerWeightedTransport.oneHole
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.BalancedFamily.eliminate Ms f) z true)
